chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a quiet glittering entrance: a single soft aurora cymbal swell rises over a low pedal, a few crystal chimes fall like ice dust, opening onto stillness}
positive_styles: suspended C major, sus2 and sus4 chords
slow glassy chime lead melody with long notes and space between
widely spaced crystal arpeggio drifting upward like cold light
very slow sustained low bass pedal
soft wide cymbal swell like an aurora swoosh every four bars instead of a beat
lonely, still, glacial, beautiful ice field under the aurora at night
